mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 0.5% indicates an accommodative monetary policy that reduces the risk-free rate, thereby increasing the present value of future equity cash flows and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 40% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 0.5%, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained unemployment rate above 5.0% indicates a weak labor market that suppresses consumer spending and corporate profits, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 40% of periods when UNRATE > 5.0%, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A positive interaction between housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicates strong consumer spending and economic expansion, which boosts corporate earnings and generates positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The interaction term between HOUST and RSAFS does not produce a positive Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows, or SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 40% of instances where the interaction term is positive.

mechanism_narrative: A CPI index above 220.0 indicates elevated inflation, prompting the Federal Reserve to tighten monetary policy, which increases discount rates and reduces equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 40% of periods when CPIAUCSL > 220.0, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A high level of payroll employment (above 130,000 thousand) indicates a robust labor market that supports consumer spending and corporate earnings, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 40% of periods when PAYEMS > 130,000, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production below 95.0 (relative to 2017=100) signals a contraction in manufacturing and supply chain activity, reducing corporate output and profits, which leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 40% of periods when INDPRO < 95.0, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A positive interaction between quarterly GDP (GDPC1) and monthly housing starts (HOUST) indicates robust economic growth and strong consumer demand, which drives corporate earnings and generates positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The interaction term between GDPC1 and HOUST does not produce a positive Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows, or SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 40% of instances where the interaction term is positive.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime, high retail sales (RSAFS above 380,000 million) signal strong consumer spending that is sustainable in the near term, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 40% of periods in the late-cycle expansion regime when RSAFS > 380,000, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows for the late-cycle expansion regime is below 0.03.
